<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_OnlineShop" targetNamespace="http://example.com/online-shop">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Purchase" name="Purchase items from an online shop" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Purchase">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_User" name="User">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Order</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Login</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InitialSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectItems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetPaymentMethod</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InitialJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectReward</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PaymentChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Pay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompleteInstallmentAgreement</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PaymentMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReturnChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReturnItems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_OrderComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Shop" name="Online shop">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverItems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Order" name="Order started"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Login" name="Log in to account"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InitialSplit" name="Start order setup"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectItems" name="Select items to purchase"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPaymentMethod" name="Set payment method"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InitialJoin" name="Order setup complete"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Continue independently"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectReward" name="Choose a free reward"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentChoice" name="Choose payment option"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Pay" name="Pay"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteInstallmentAgreement" name="Complete installment agreement"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentMerge" name="Payment completed"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Payment and reward selection complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverItems" name="Deliver items"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReturnChoice" name="Return items for exchange?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReturnItems" name="Return items for exchange"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderComplete" name="Order complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_Order" targetRef="Task_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Gateway_InitialSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialSplit" targetRef="Task_SelectItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialSplit" targetRef="Task_SetPaymentMethod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_SelectItems" targetRef="Gateway_InitialJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_SetPaymentMethod" targetRef="Gateway_InitialJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_SelectReward"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_SelectReward" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentChoice" targetRef="Task_Pay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentChoice" targetRef="Task_CompleteInstallmentAgreement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_Pay" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_CompleteInstallmentAgreement" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_DeliverItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_DeliverItems" targetRef="Gateway_ReturnChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_ReturnChoice" targetRef="Task_ReturnItems" name="Return for exchange"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_ReturnChoice" targetRef="End_OrderComplete" name="Do not return"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_ReturnItems" targetRef="Task_DeliverItems"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
